instruction: Candid outdoor full shot of a park lawn. Four friends stand in a line cheering. From left to right: the bald man in the blue t-shirt (R2) stands with both arms raised; the woman with the afro in the red t-shirt (R6) stands on one leg, smiling; the heavy-set man in the dark blue t-shirt (R1) stands holding a blue cloth with both arms raised; and the woman in the dark blue t-shirt (R4) stands with her left arm raised, smiling. In the background, a blurry person in black walks past. Natural daylight illuminates the scene.
